bash -c 'snap() {
  cat /proc/uptime
  head -n 1 /proc/stat
  if [ -n "$1" ]; then
    cg=$(systemctl show --property ControlGroup --value "$1")
    if [ -n "$cg" ]; then
      grep '"'"'^usage_usec '"'"' "/sys/fs/cgroup$cg/cpu.stat" 2>/dev/null
    fi
  fi
}
unit=$1
shift
echo '"'"'#cpu-before'"'"' >&2
snap "$unit" >&2
"$@" &
pid=$!
for _ in $(seq 5); do
  sleep 1
  kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null || break
done
echo '"'"'#ss'"'"' >&2
ss -tinH state established '"'"'( dport = :5201 )'"'"' >&2
wait "$pid"
rc=$?

snap "$unit" >&2
exit "$rc"
